definitions.full: H923. bahat בַּ֫הַט noun [masculine] a costly stone , perhaps porphyry (compare Egyptian behiti , behet , behat Brugsch Dict. v. 438 Dümichen Geschichte 167 f. Wendel Altäg. Bau- u. Edelsteine (1888) 77 f. ; ᵐ5 has σμαραγδίτης ), Est 1:6 ב וְסֹחָ֑רֶת׳ִרצֲפַת וְדַר וָֿשֵׁשׁ עַל upon a pavement of porphyry and marble , etc.
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (probably meaning to glisten);
